configure_mask2former_coco_model: configure Mask2Former R50 model for COCO instance segmentation with 80 classes and LSJ augmentation
build_train_pipeline_coco: build a data pipeline for COCO training with random flip, large-scale jittering, and random crop augmentations
configure_data_preprocessor: configure DetDataPreprocessor with ImageNet normalization, BGR-to-RGB conversion, and batch fixed-size padding
setup_coco_dataloader: setup COCO dataloaders for train and validation splits with instance segmentation annotations
configure_coco_evaluator: configure CocoMetric evaluator for bounding box and segmentation metrics on COCO validation set
